query:
SELECT
            c.id AS id,
            c.role AS role,
            c.content AS content,
            c.chat_id AS chat_id
        FROM conversations AS c
        LEFT JOIN chunks AS ch
            ON ch.source_type = 'conversation' AND ch.source_id = c.id
        WHERE c.user_id = ? AND ch.id IS NULL
        ORDER BY c.id
        LIMIT ?
